candidates.explanation: JwtStrategy verifies access tokens using 'auth.refreshSecret'. Access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret', so signature verification always fails and every protected request gets 401. Login and refresh still work because JwtRefreshStrategy uses the refresh secret correctly.

fix.description: Use 'auth.secret' instead of 'auth.refreshSecret' as secretOrKey in JwtStrategy.
